landing.heroTitle: Organize your work. See what's left.
landing.heroSubtitle: Assign tasks and follow progress — on your own, or with people you invite.
landing.contactLead: Questions, implementation ideas, or more information? Use
landing.demoCaption: A day’s work: restock, inventory, supplier reply.
landing.featuresLead: Tasks and due dates. That’s the picture.

simple.title: Board or list
simple.body: See what’s open, in progress, and done — without dashboards in the way.

calm.title: Invite when you need to
calm.body: Start alone, or bring people in by email. Shared work lives in the same group.

relay.title: No measuring people
relay.body: We don’t rank people or track velocity. Tasks and due dates are enough.

what.a: A simple task board — assign work, follow progress, stay clear of productivity metrics.

groups.a: Start a group for yourself, or invite others by email. Tasks stay inside each group, any size.

metrics.a: No. No leaderboards, velocity charts, or surveillance KPIs — just tasks and due dates.

data.a: On SirRelay servers (PostgreSQL). Signed-in pages are never cached by the browser; the session uses one essential cookie.

editor.title: Your column, in the editor.
editor.subtitle: The same tasks in VS Code, Cursor, or Antigravity — and the same API key for the SirRelay MCP. The sidebar shows only the work assigned to you.
editor.pointYours: Other people's tasks stay on the web.
